propositions: Duplicate allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) should return cached results without re-executing the underlying tool, with exactly one real execution per unique signature.
Error-prefixed result strings (e.g. 'Error: cannot read x') must not be cached and must re-execute on retry, as outcomes may differ on subsequent attempts.
Deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)', '(empty)', and '(empty range)' must be cached and memoized to eliminate pathological loops such as the 62x repeated search_files case.

Nudge escalation must progress from a level-1 generic repeat message on first duplicate to a level-2 stronger nudge on further repeats, with both text byte-stable across runs for provider prompt caching.
The existing runaway guard (distinct-ratio actuator) must continue observing all memoized duplicates and trip the abort threshold unchanged; memoization occurs within the guard's outer wrapper.
Only read-only allowlisted tools are memoized; write or non-deterministic tools like record_criterion_verdict always execute and are never cached.
